rich_narrative.summary: The Islamic Educational Foundation operates full-time Islamic schools in New Jersey, including Al-Ghazaly Jr/Sr High School and Al-Hikmah Elementary School <cite id="1">founded in 1983</cite>. In FY2025, the organization reported <cite id="2">Total Revenue of $5,631,488</cite>, supported primarily by tuition and program revenue alongside contributions. Across its operations, the foundation served <cite id="1">621 enrolled students</cite> during the academic calendar. Financial records indicate a filed <cite id="2">Program expense ratio of 71.5%</cite> in primary reporting, while evaluated score metrics reflect a historical 72% program ratio baseline. The foundation holds <cite id="1">16.3 months of working capital reserves</cite>, offering substantial short-term operational balance. However, program spending efficiency trails the <cite id="1">peer median of 87.7%</cite> for international and faith-based education providers. Cost per student averages $8,793, representing significant capital requirements per beneficiary. Donors can support operations via general <cite id="3">sadaqah educational contributions</cite>.
